video_selection: Lexicographically first retained-test animal/daily/sport + original legacy holdout; fixed rule before scores

training_config.recipe: Original causal H3 Conv3d + frozen bidirectional teacher + HR decoder-aware pixels
training_config.initialization: Warm start from selected old causal eWarp weights verbatim; no repeated aligned-past transform; fresh AdamW
training_config.dropout_mode: disabled: original model.eval() with parameter gradients enabled
training_config.dtype_scope: FP32 parameter/input tensors; NPU internal convolution/matmul precision follows the recorded HF32 flags
training_config.selection: Minimum mean dev RGB L1 + 0.2 LPIPS on fixed full-spatial native temporal regions, including step0
training_config.pixel_target: Frozen H3 decoder of HR reference latent; not teacher pixels
training_config.pixel_sampling: One full-spatial native block every4 updates, otherwise one native spatial tile interior; 4 LPIPS frames per region
training_config.temporal_pixel_scope: Non-crossfaded real RGB positions only; no synthetic tail RGB
training_config.padding: MSE/KD first36, eWarp35; token36 retained as decoder context and can receive pixel gradients
training_config.causal_scope: Causal latent upscaler only; frozen original decoder remains noncausal
training_config.test_reuse: Retained16 test +3 legacy, previously inspected; not a new blind test
training_config.loss_definition: 1 HR latent MSE + .25 teacher latent MSE + .1 eWarp + 1 RGB L1 + .2 LPIPS alex v0.1

adapter_structure.causal_groupnorm_dependency: current frame channels and spatial dimensions

metric_comparison.historical_latent_metrics: Copied from SHA-bound completed CMN hybrid evaluation and verified against its original CMN history; identical pairs and metric definitions
metric_comparison.conv3d_hybrid: Retained345M causal Conv3d warmstarted from old causal eWarp and trained with teacher/pixel supervision; no inference ensemble
metric_comparison.cmn_hybrid: Previous1061336parameter CMN after the same hybrid loss recipe
metric_comparison.old_causal_ewarp: Historical345M causal Conv3d upscaler, not Method2
metric_comparison.common_latent_objective: HR latent MSE and eWarp components; not the hybrid composite training objective

pixel_metric_scope: Only four fixed videos (3 retained test +1 legacy); full120frames, not the all16 test mean

pixel_metric_targets.primary: Matched HR latent decoded by the same frozen VAE
pixel_metric_targets.secondary: Original120 HR source RGB frames, including VAE reconstruction error

lpips_recipe.input: Uncompressed decoded uint8 RGB, converted to [-1,1]; no resize/crop
lpips_recipe.aggregation: Mean of per-frame scalar LPIPS over120frames

causal_scope: Causal Conv3d hybrid upsampler on fixed latents only; original frozen H3 decoder is noncausal; upstream encoding is outside this audit

padding_context.note: Unsupervised latent36 still enters the final noncausal VAE window z30..36. Region-specific temporal-difference metrics omit the cross-region frame101->102 pair.

warmed_upsampler_timing.scope: Upsampler only, FP32, B=1, input already on device; excludes VAE, I/O and transfer
warmed_upsampler_timing.warmup: Two full forwards plus one complete 37-step stream
warmed_upsampler_timing.stream_note: Per-step synchronization is included; full and streaming calls use different batching
